method.requests: Unchanged retained Phase F explicit-Newton requests; config hashes included per run
method.native: Same frozen metadata-only native executable and Rust sources for both variants
method.concurrency: Existing eight-worker native pool unchanged; jobs sequential in fresh processes/data roots
method.timing_scope: Numerical solve/postprocessing and field extraction; excludes HTTP, durable UI saving and playback drawing
method.sample_limit: Two observations per variant/case; ranges are not confidence intervals
method.recorded_solver_work: solver_cpu_time_s is the existing compatibility name for summed native report elapsed timings, not an OS CPU counter

excluded_timing.drone-baseline: Exploratory physics run overlapped a snapshot verifier early; retained for physics only

method.quiet_measurements: No competing task builds, tests, archives or comparers during the primary timing cohort

physics.purpose: Retained-artifact physics equivalence evidence for the two-layer solution-reuse change; independent of the timing cohort and repeat timing measurements.
physics.oracle: Actual baseline native solutions on the derived target meshes are the numerical oracle. Replaying the candidate synthesis helper is the implementation under test, not the oracle; its synthesized phase flux and selected torque are also checked against the actual candidate aggregate consumed by the run.
physics.interpretation: Pass establishes a strict regression comparison for these retained discretizations and requests; it does not extend the physical qualification envelope or claim absolute motor-model accuracy.

numeric_policy.floor_units: Units are those of the numeric observable at each path. Ordered substring rules are reproduced exactly, including their precedence for nested d/q paths; selected metrics carry their actual floor below.
numeric_policy.rhs_exception: Existing slot_current_pattern_matches eligibility gate is asserted separately for every synthesized pair. Preserve array length and missing-value mask, let Jscale=max(abs(base_J),abs(target_J)) over all present elements, and require max_abs_delta_J <= 1e-9*Jscale. An all-zero RHS has zero allowed and observed error; its relative ratio is undefined, not a claimed nonzero tolerance.
numeric_policy.finite_values_and_shapes: Nonfinite numbers, array shape/length mismatches and missing structural keys fail the comparison.
numeric_policy.bounds_not_inferred_from_solver_residual: The requested Newton residual tolerance is not used as an output error guarantee. Output bounds were fixed before the native-pair/full-field comparisons; only the supplementary RHS observer was corrected from a pointwise scalar floor to the existing global-norm eligibility criterion, without changing any output bounds.

exact_structure_checks: Identical request physics config and resolved config; both statuses COMPLETE.
Identical binary, Rust-source and solver-Python hashes between the compared pair; intentional mesh-rotation helper change is not claimed identical.
Candidate native report names are a subset of baseline names; direct same-angle native mesh bytes are identical.
For synthesized targets: complete unique (global slot, physical layer) coverage; slot/layer identities, phase, direction, turns-per-coil and turn fractions equal the independently solved target.
For synthesized targets: unchanged triangle connectivity, element material-region assignment, region kind/material mapping, boundary nodes and sector-edge pairing.
Independent rigid node rotation and magnetization rotation checked numerically; per-element current eligibility and missing-value masks checked explicitly.
Full decoded playback frame name inventory, position indices, electrical angles, record counts, connectivity and regions match; all decoded numeric fields compared.

excluded_from_physical_parity.treatment: Not asserted numerically equal. Native report/frame counts are reported as work counters, not physics measurements.

items: timestamps and descriptive runtime identities inside solve_metadata
excluded_from_physical_parity.treatment: Not published or treated as physical observables; request config and selected source/binary equivalence checks are independent.

items: other raw native result diagnostics outside the selected physical invariant subset, including diagnostic explanation strings
excluded_from_physical_parity.treatment: Every raw native results leaf was observed in a separate diagnostic section. These fields are not all claimed equal after rotation; all paths exceeding the same generic numeric gate and all changed diagnostic strings are enumerated per case below. Selected physical torque, phase flux, energies, A_z and full playback B retain their strict primary gates.

physics.diagnostic_caveat: Synthesis copies the source solve’s fixed-global-angle contour samples and quadrant allocations. Their coordinates/triangle selections and local samples need not equal a fresh target-angle sampling, even when the selected torque and rotated physical field agree. Treat them as source-solve diagnostics; transform or mark them before using them as target-angle diagnostics.
